assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The site and all three key-area polygons are repository-maintained rough geometry, not official planning boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, intersections, figures and phase extents must be recomputed after official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: No cleared parcel, ownership, existing-building survey, heritage-control, tree, utility, fire-safety or traffic-capacity dataset is available in the site package.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints, public rooms, seams and renewal actions are conceptual prototypes rather than parcel-level retain-renovate-demolish or engineering decisions.

assumptions.statement: Named operators, event calendars, funding, procurement and public-service responsibilities remain to be agreed by authorized parties.
assumptions.impact: The proposal describes governance roles and stage gates, not confirmed government or investment commitments.
